steps: A charged particle moving parallel to an electric field experiences force F=qE in the same or opposite direction, resulting in linear motion.
A charged particle moving perpendicular to a uniform electric field experiences constant transverse force F=qE, resulting in parabolic trajectory.
A charged particle moving parallel to a magnetic field experiences zero Lorentz force (F=qvB sin(0)=0), resulting in constant velocity straight line motion.
A charged particle moving perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field experiences constant centripetal force F=qvB, resulting in circular motion.
